There is no direct shortcut to switch from one to another and back, but 
there are shortcuts to go to the console (alt 5) and to go to the script 
(alt 0)

those can be changed in settings-> configure shortcuts

hope this helps

Matthieu

messages.subject: [rkward-users] Shortcut key to switch between R console and script window
messages.subject_clean: [rkward-users] Shortcut key to switch between R console and script window
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

On Thursday 14 October 2010, Joergensen Terje wrote:
> It works great, but I miss a shortcut key to easily switch between the
> script window and the R console without having to use the mouse.

it's on our TODO list, but it will probably be a while before a developer finds 
the time to look into this (it's not as trivial as it may seem).

Besides using Alt+5 and Alt+0, as Matthieu suggests, here are two more interim 
solutions:
- Use Alt+5 repeatedly (has the side-effect of showing/hiding the console).
- Detach the console window (Windows->Detach) and use Alt+Tab.

Regards
Thomas

messages.subject: [rkward-users] ubuntu repo still useful?
messages.body_plain:
hi,

a short question: does anyone still have use for the unoffial ubuntu 
repository i've maintained so far? since we have different launchpad PPA repos 
now, the only real use case i can think of would be support for rather old 
releases of (k)ubuntu with CRAN packages of R, but i can't say how many 
inconsistencies there are, actually.

if there are no complaints, there will be no further releases through that 
repository. otherwise, just let me know if the launchpad releases don't work 
for you, of course i'll keep what's still of use.

> 
> the R engine seems to initalize ok but I get no output. Could someone shed
> some light on this for me or suggest what setting(s) I may need to change
> to get rkward to function properly.

RKWard 0.5.3 does not work properly with R 2.12.0. Either downgrade R to 
2.11.1, or upgrade RKWard to 0.5.4.

Regards
Thomas
